class.name: OcgGraphic3dStructuremanager
class.brief_description: This class allows the definition of a manager to which the graphic objects are associated. It allows them to be globally manipulated. It defines the global attributes. Keywords: Structure, Structure Manager, Update Mode, Destroy, Highlight, Visible
class.description: ! This class allows the definition of a manager to ! which the graphic objects are associated. ! It allows them to be globally manipulated. ! It defines the global attributes. ! Keywords: Structure, Structure Manager, Update Mode, ! Destroy, Highlight, Visible

method.name: Graphic3d_StructureManager
method.description: Initializes the ViewManager. Currently creating of more than 100 viewer instances is not supported and leads to InitializationError and initialization failure. This limitation might be addressed in some future OCCT releases. Warning: Raises InitialisationError if the initialization of the ViewManager failed.

method.name: Update
method.description: Invalidates bounding box of specified ZLayerId.

method.name: Remove
method.description: Deletes and erases the 3D structure manager.

method.name: Erase_1
method.description: Erases all the structures.

method.name: ReCompute_1
method.description: Forces a new construction of the structure. if <theStructure> is displayed and TOS_COMPUTED.

method.name: ReCompute_2
method.description: Forces a new construction of the structure. if <theStructure> is displayed in <theProjector> and TOS_COMPUTED.

method.name: Display
method.description: Display the structure.

method.name: Erase_2
method.description: Erases the structure.

method.name: Highlight
method.description: Highlights the structure.

method.name: SetTransform
method.description: Transforms the structure.

method.name: ChangeDisplayPriority
method.description: Changes the display priority of the structure <AStructure>.

method.name: ChangeZLayer
method.description: Change Z layer for structure. The Z layer mechanism allows to display structures in higher layers in overlay of structures in lower layers.

method.name: GraphicDriver
method.description: Returns the graphic driver of <me>.

method.name: MaxNumOfViews
method.description: Returns the theoretical maximum number of definable views in the manager. Warning: It's not possible to accept an infinite number of definable views because each view must have an identification and we have different managers.

method.name: Identification_2
method.description: Returns the structure with the identification number <AId>.

method.name: UnHighlight_2
method.description: Suppress the highlighting on the structure <AStructure>.

method.name: UnHighlight_1
method.description: Suppresses the highlighting on all the structures in <me>.

method.name: RecomputeStructures
method.description: Recomputes all structures in the manager. Resets Device Lost flag.

method.name: IsDeviceLost
method.description: Returns TRUE if Device Lost flag has been set and presentation data should be reuploaded onto graphics driver.

method.name: SetDeviceLost
method.description: Sets Device Lost flag.

method.name: DumpJson
method.description: Dumps the content of me into the stream
